commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Propagate tensor encodings outside dispatch regions (#24966)

Encoding propagation is currently tied to dispatch hoisting, which
prevents layout assignment from using the same rewrite rules on the
surrounding tensor graph.

Separate where propagation may happen from the rewrites themselves, and
add the function pass
`iree-dispatch-creation-propagate-data-tiling-encodings` for propagation
outside dispatches. Hoisting keeps its existing behavior. The new pass
stops at existing dispatches and block boundaries, and constant CSE
stays disabled because Flow regions do not materialize constants
themselves.

- `iree-dispatch-creation-propagate-encodings` runs in the dispatch-time
data-tiling pipeline and only swaps `set_encoding` with `tensor.cast`
producers, so adding these rewrites to it would change that pipeline.
They stay separate until bubbling through generic ops goes through the
encoding propagation interfaces (TODO(#20179)).
- Bubbling now stops at `set_encoding` ops whose encoding is not an
`EncodingAttr`, such as `#iree_encoding.padding`, instead of crashing.
`iree-dispatch-creation-hoist-encoding-ops` could already hit this
within dispatches; both passes have a regression test.

No pipeline runs the new pass yet. #24969 adds it to the experimental
early data-tiling route.

This is one of five PRs adding an experimental CPU path that
materializes data-tiling layouts before dispatch creation, so that
`linalg.mmt4d` and data-tiled convolutions fuse with their elementwise
epilogues and result unpacks.

commit_message:
[CI] Add RDNA3 and RDNA4 Vulkan SPIR-V e2e tests under rocjitsu (#24990)

Add CPU-hosted Vulkan compute e2e coverage for gfx1100 and gfx1201 to
the existing Linux Clang CI job alongside the six ROCm targets. Move
that job to Ubuntu 24.04 with official Mesa RADV and Vulkan
validation-layer packages, and let RADV compile the existing SPIR-V
modules to each simulated GPU's instructions.

Keep one job, one regular IREE build, and one packaged TheRock SDK
pinned to `10.2.0a20261006`. Preserve `build_all.sh` and regular CTest
coverage, then reuse the build for HIP and Vulkan. The wheel's rocjitsu
revision `81d4fa340ce8` includes the SDMA count fix from
https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-systems/pull/12708.

Verify the RADV driver and simulated PCI device identity before CTest.
Use eight simulator test workers, a 60-minute Vulkan step timeout, and
per-target logs and JUnit results. Run both simulator suites after a
successful build even if an earlier test suite fails.

The fresh build also exposed a missing dependency on generated
`PluginABIHash.h`; explicitly order generation before its consumers
compile.

Assisted-by: codex
name: Tag candidate release

commit_message:
[CI] Run Vulkan HAL CTS under rocjitsu

Extend the Vulkan simulator helper to select HAL CTS alongside the
existing e2e tests on gfx1100 and gfx1201. Reuse the same CI job, build,
and pinned TheRock SDK.

Give the raw SPIR-V CTS executable a five-minute timeout. Its concurrent
replay case submits two dispatches of 8M workgroups and takes just over
a minute on simulated gfx1100, exceeding the previous 60-second limit.
Regenerate the CMake test definition from Bazel.

The assertions-enabled local run passes all 192 selected test executables
on each GPU, including 43 HAL CTS executables, with existing per-case
capability skips retained. Shell, actionlint, and pre-commit checks pass.

Assisted-by: codex

[CI] Run Vulkan HAL CTS under rocjitsu

Extend the Vulkan simulator helper to select HAL CTS alongside the
existing e2e tests on gfx1100 and gfx1201. Reuse the same CI job, build,
and pinned TheRock SDK.

Give the raw SPIR-V CTS executable a five-minute timeout. Its concurrent
replay case submits two dispatches of 8M workgroups and takes just over
a minute on simulated gfx1100, exceeding the previous 60-second limit.
Regenerate the CMake test definition from Bazel.

The assertions-enabled local run passes all 192 selected test executables
on each GPU, including 43 HAL CTS executables, with existing per-case
capability skips retained. Shell, actionlint, and pre-commit checks pass.

Assisted-by: codex
